about.label: The Developer
about.title: Engineering
about.intro1: I am Jônatas Nascimento (Jhon), Software Architect and Senior Full-Stack Engineer focused on solving business challenges through scalable technology and high-performance architectures in the global market.
about.intro2: I have led highly critical GovTech and corporate SaaS initiatives. My deliverables include deploying asynchronous runtimes (Laravel Octane, Swoole, FrankenPHP) that maintain in-memory state for low-latency request handling, alongside AI R&D pipelines (OpenAI Assistants, RAG, database-connected Function Calling) secured via strict JSON Schema. I operate fluently on remote Linux servers via SSH, debugging transactional concurrency (race conditions) and building automated CI/CD pipelines.
about.stackText: My engineering revolves around the modern Laravel/PHP ecosystem utilizing high-performance stateful runtimes, coupled with reactive front-ends built on React 19 and Inertia.js. My preference for Livewire and Blade is architectural, minimizing network overhead, retaining state cohesion, and maximizing critical render speeds.
about.timelineSubtitle: Great architectures aren't built overnight; they are forged under pressure. This is my background's evolution:

timeline.desc: Physical infrastructure services, local area networks setup, OS management, and private server administration.

timeline.desc: Operating under intense business pressure, managing concurrent workflows under strict delivery SLAs. This operational resilience serves as my SRE and fault-tolerance philosophical foundation.

timeline.title: The Base (SENAC)
timeline.desc: Academic background focusing on web systems fundamentals, database relational modeling, and monolithic software design patterns.

timeline.title: End-to-End Architect (Freelancer)
timeline.desc: Full technical ownership of design, implementation, and deployment of end-to-end platforms (Cafeteria Damore, JYNSGE News), integrating Stripe and Supabase under automated CI/CD.

timeline.title: Tech Lead & Architect (LUMEN Consultoria)
timeline.desc: Lead architect for B2G SaaS Enterprise Platform Lumen. Upgraded legacy runtime to Laravel Octane + FrankenPHP, cutting response latency by 50%. Led AI R&D for structured document compilation and mitigated critical concurrency/race conditions on legacy systems.

timeline.title: The Anchor (UNIVESP)
timeline.desc: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, cementing deep knowledge in computer hardware, digital logic, and low-level system designs.
